0022600180.text: The Cavaliers (4-3, 1-2 on the road, coming off a loss) visit the Oklahoma City Thunder (5-2, 3-0 at home, coming off a win) for Cleveland's eighth game of the season, and the Cavaliers sit second in the Central, two games back, and fourth in the East. Cleveland is without Jaylon Tyson (ankle sprain) and Peyton Watson (hamstring soreness), while Oklahoma City is missing Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder, surgery), Chet Holmgren (knee), Jalen Williams (leg, fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee). The Cavaliers trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 117-112 in Cleveland on November 2, 2026, and they were swept 0-2 by the Thunder in the 2025-26 season.
